text:
Lena (CS): putting together a short customer-facing playbook for go-live: prefill/prefetch, small-batch defaults, streaming fallback. want it compact and non-technical. ideas?
Omar (FieldOps): call out jitter on prefill TTLs and conservative batch_size defaults (2-6). many customers spike when everyone warms at once.
Vik (SRE): add a 3-step fallback: retry stream with backoff -> switch to non-stream gen -> route to a lighter fallback model. include a per-route max latency budget.
Nina (CSM): please map these to renewal-risk signals. simple: 1-week timeouts = high risk, repeated low-quality = medium, steady = low. that helps prioritization.
OnboardBot: attach example dashboard -> https://console.redwood/onboard/example
Lena (CS): snippets should be <=12 lines so sales can paste in emails. propose three snippets: prefetch (warm KV), tiny adaptive batcher, streaming fallback policy.
Omar (FieldOps): prefill guidance: conv TTL 45-90s, assistant profiles 3-6min, jitter +/-20%. also recommend staged warmup windows (10m, 30m, 60m) before big launches.
Vik (SRE): short pseudo prefetch:
# prefetch
if not cache.has(key):
  resp = model.call(prefix, max_tokens=0)
  cache.set(key, resp.kv_head, ttl=int(base_ttl * rand(0.8,1.2)))
Lena (CS): batch example (adaptive):
# tiny batcher
batch.add(req)
if batch.size >= 4 or wait_ms > 20:
  send(batch)
  if p95_latency > target: batch.size = max(1, batch.size - 1)
Vik (SRE): fallback policy example (one-line JSON): {"route":"/chat","fallback_model":"redwood-lite","max_latency_ms":1200}
Nina (CSM): for the runbook include: one-line summary, quick checklist (flags to flip), when to escalate to CS/SE, feedback form link. keep language PM-friendly.
Omar (FieldOps): ops tip: make batch_size route-configurable; embeddings routes can use larger batches while chat routes stay small. also include a tiny cron to trigger prefill.
Lena (CS): action items: Nina drafts risk mapping + feedback form by EOD; Vik adds telemetry keys and short prometheus queries; Omar writes warmup cron + jitter notes; I'll assemble one-pager and email snippets.
Vik (SRE): telemetry keys: cache_hit_ratio, avg_batch_size, stream_error_rate, p95_latency, fallback_count. will paste queries after draft.
OnboardBot: reminder set: send 72h post-go-live checklist to customer.
Nina (CSM): good plan, will review the draft and add CSM copy for the 7-day check-in.
Lena (CS): thanks team, will share the draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
